mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as observed across multiple monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS is below the 25th percentile of its historical distribution over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) exceeding 2000 thousand units signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 2000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 200) indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL < 200, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions characterized by low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns due to sustained corporate profit growth and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of the absolute level.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO is above the 50th percentile of its historical distribution over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales level (RSAFS) exceeding 350,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS > 350000, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong payroll growth (PAYEMS increasing) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0) indicates a tight labor market and robust economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE < 5.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of expanding industrial production (INDPRO > 118), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns due to strong manufacturing output and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 118, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.02.
